The sentiment trend indicates a significant decline in user satisfaction. Initially, the product may have had a neutral or positive reception, but one month post-release, frustration has grown due to unresolved software issues and a perceived lack of timely updates. This has led to a shift where negative reviews are outnumbering positive ones, signaling a worrying trajectory for the company's reputation.

Regarding the primary material of a candle, it is typically made of wax. Common types of wax include paraffin, beeswax, soy wax, and palm wax. The wax serves as the fuel source that melts and is drawn up the wick to sustain the flame.
